item_fields.context_label: string|null; deal or notification subject name
item_fields.open_url: string|null; relative destination or source notification deep link
item_fields.merged_source_ids: UUID[]; canonical source IDs collapsed into this card
item_fields.action_id: UUID|null; next_action or capture_post_call_action ID for complete-one-action
item_fields.action_version: integer|null; canonical action version, sent as complete-one-action base_version
item_fields.deal_id: UUID|null; owning deal for completion readback, null for non-deal work
item_fields.auto_settled: boolean; canonical resolution placed this item in Settled without a disposition write
item_fields.review_reference: home-review.v1 reference|null; exact item and source version with candidate domain operations; load read-home-review for current detail and available operations
item_fields.completed_at: UTC ISO-8601 instant|null; proven canonical completion, never activity or ingestion time
item_fields.waiting_on: null|{identity:{kind:party|actor,id:UUID,display_name:string|null,available:boolean},reason:string,evidence:string[],version:integer}; explicit canonical identity only, null for unknown or completed work
item_fields.waiting_version: integer; independent relationship version, 0 before the first command; pass as waiting command base_version
item_fields.settlement: null|{at:UTC ISO-8601|null,actor_id:UUID|null,method:single|bulk|automatic,batch_id:UUID|null}; current settlement evidence; legacy manual settlement is null; automatic actor is null and time is proven completed_at or null
item_fields.snooze: null|{at:UTC ISO-8601,actor_id:UUID,method:single|bulk,batch_id:UUID|null}; current snooze evidence, legacy unknown is null
item_fields.last_disposition_change: null|{at:UTC ISO-8601,actor_id:UUID,method:single|bulk,batch_id:UUID|null,action:settle|snooze|unsettle|unsnooze,request_key:UUID}; latest successful manual command; undo has its own time; replay adds no event

truncated: boolean; the item limit or 10000-notification scan bound was exceeded
ordering: Unfinished first, newest activity first, item ID as tie breaker
completion: Only task items have action_id and action_version. Complete the representative action only; merged_source_ids are display provenance, never a bulk completion instruction. No task reopening verb is added.
settlement: Canonical done tasks, sent replies, resolved fact reviews and received tour feedback settle automatically. A future snooze and explicit un-settle take precedence. Notification completion and call-processing completion do not prove all underlying work resolved. Tour feedback resolves only for the exact share grant that received a client shortlist or comment. Versions remain the existing disposition-command authority; retry exact requests and hydrate receipts through this read.
completion_time: Done ordinary tasks use the exact complete-one-action, complete-action or complete-deal-item event, superseded by reopen-one-action. Done call actions use completed_at. Sent replies use send_result.sent_at. Open work, unsupported sources and unproven legacy completions return null. Later notifications never move completion. Clients group by America/Chicago.
history: Metadata is actor-scoped. Bulk uses the command idempotency key as shared batch_id; single uses null. Unsettle clears settlement. Exact snooze undo restores prior settlement evidence. Legacy times are never inferred from updated_at. Automatic settlement remains a read-only canonical projection.
recent_settles: read-recently-settled-home-inbox returns home-recent-settles.v1, limit 1..100 default 20; current known-time settlements in this bounded Home snapshot, newest settlement time first then item_id. Unknown times excluded. Propagates Home truncated; it is not an exhaustive historical export. Unsettled or snoozed cards are excluded. Undo manual bulk via existing reversible command batch_id; single or automatic via unsettle-home-inbox and current base_version.
